Average_Period_fixed_monthly_middle_of_month: 6 months

key_definitions.Partnership: The relation between persons who have agreed to share the profits of a business carried on by all or any of them acting for all. (Section 4, Indian Partnership Act 1932)
key_definitions.Partnership_Deed: Document containing the terms and conditions of the agreement in writing among partners.
key_definitions.Goodwill: The good name or reputation of a business which helps it to earn more profits than others. Intangible, NOT fictitious asset.
key_definitions.Reconstitution: Any change in the existing agreement of partnership amounts to reconstitution of a firm.
key_definitions.Sacrificing_Ratio: Ratio in which old partners sacrifice their share of profit = Old Share – New Share
key_definitions.Gaining_Ratio: Ratio in which continuing partners gain the share of retiring partner = New Share – Old Share
key_definitions.Revaluation_Account: A nominal account prepared to record changes in asset/liability values. Also called Profit & Loss Adjustment Account.
key_definitions.Dissolution_of_Firm: Dissolution of partnership among ALL partners — business also comes to an end.
key_definitions.Dissolution_of_Partnership: Change in agreement — firm may continue.
key_definitions.Realisation_Account: Nominal account opened on dissolution to determine profit or loss on realisation of assets and payment of liabilities.
key_definitions.Company: An incorporated association which is an artificial person created by law, having a separate legal entity with a perpetual succession and a common seal.
key_definitions.Share: The capital of a company divided into small units of fixed face value.
key_definitions.Debenture: An instrument acknowledging a debt issued under the common seal of the company.
key_definitions.Financial_Statements: Final products of accounting process — Balance Sheet, Statement of P&L, Notes to Accounts, Cash Flow Statement.
key_definitions.Ratio: Arithmetical expression of relationship between two related or interdependent items. Father: Benjamin Graham.
key_definitions.Cash_Flow_Statement: Statement showing changes in financial position in terms of cash and cash equivalents between two balance sheet dates.
key_definitions.Cash_Equivalents: Short-term highly liquid investments readily convertible into known amounts of cash (AS-3).

important_provisions_no_deed.Management: Every partner has equal right to participate

key_mcq_facts.Interest_on_drawings_is: Income for the firm (credited to P&L Appropriation Account)
key_mcq_facts.Rent_to_partner_shown_in: P&L Account (NOT P&L Appropriation Account) — it is a charge against profits
key_mcq_facts.Goodwill_distributed_in: Sacrificing ratio (not old ratio, not new ratio)
key_mcq_facts.Debentureholder_entitled_to: Interest at fixed rate (NOT dividend, NOT voting rights)
key_mcq_facts.Discount_on_issue_of_debentures: Capital loss (shown on assets side or written off against Securities Premium)
key_mcq_facts.Securities_premium_transferred_to: Securities Premium Reserve Account (NOT P&L Account)
key_mcq_facts.Forfeited_shares_reissued_at: Any price — at par, premium or discount (but not below paid-up amount)
key_mcq_facts.Capital_Reserve_arises: On re-issue of forfeited shares — remaining balance in Share Forfeiture A/c
key_mcq_facts.Investing_activities: Acquisition and disposal of long-term assets
key_mcq_facts.Financing_activities: Change in size and composition of owner's capital and borrowings

mcq_q1_q10: Q1. For the firm, interest on partner's drawing is a/an — Ans: (c) income
Q2. The excess of average profit over normal profit is called — Ans: (a) super profit
Q3. Profits of last 3 years ₹6,000, ₹13,000, ₹8,000. Goodwill at 2 years purchase — Ans: (d) ₹18,000
Q4. Revaluation gains and losses at retirement carried by — Ans: (a) remaining partners
Q5. On dissolution, final balance of capital account transferred to — Ans: (a) realisation account
Q6. A company has — Ans: (d) All of the above (separate entity, perpetual, limited liability)
Q7. Zero coupon bonds are issued — Ans: (a) at zero rate of interest
Q8. Not a part of financial statement of company — Ans: (c) Ledger account
Q9. Not a profitability ratio — Ans: (d) Current ratio
Q10. Cash flow statement prepared from — Ans: (d) All of these

important_formula_sheets.note: All critical formulas for UP Board Accountancy 2026. Memorise exactly.

formulas: Interest_on_Capital: Interest = Amount of Capital × Rate/100 × Time
Interest_on_Drawings_Simple: Interest = Amount × Rate/100 × Months Remaining/12
Interest_on_Drawings_Product: Interest = Total Products × Rate/100 × 1/12
Average_Period_Drawings_beginning: Average Period = (n+1)/2 months where n = number of months
Average_Period_fixed_monthly_beginning_of_month: 6.5 months
Average_Period_fixed_monthly_end_of_month: 5.5 months
Average_Period_fixed_monthly_middle_of_month: 6 months
Opening_Capital_formula: Opening Capital = Closing Capital + Drawings – Profit – Additional Capital introduced
Interest_on_Capital_case3_charge_against_profits: Allowed fully even if loss
New_PSR: New Profit Sharing Ratio = Old Share – Sacrificing Share
Sacrificing_Ratio: Sacrificing Ratio = Old Share – New Share
Average_Profit_Method_Goodwill: Goodwill = Average Profit × Number of Years Purchase
Average_Profit: Average Profit = Sum of Profits / Number of Years
Super_Profit_Method_Goodwill: Goodwill = Super Profit × Number of Years Purchase
Super_Profit: Super Profit = Average Profit – Normal Profit
Normal_Profit: Normal Profit = Capital Employed × Normal Rate of Return / 100
Capitalisation_of_Average_Profit: Capitalised Value = Average Profit × 100 / Normal Rate of Return
Hidden_Goodwill: Hidden Goodwill = Inferred Firm Value – Net Assets of Firm
Firm_Goodwill_from_new_partner_share: Firm's Goodwill = New Partner's Goodwill Contribution × (1 / New Partner's Share)
New_PSR_retirement: New Ratio = Old Share + Acquired Gaining Share
Gaining_Ratio: Gaining Ratio = New Share – Old Share
Min_subscription_SEBI: 90% of entire issue
Min_application_money: 5% of face value
Securities_Premium: Credited to Securities Premium Reserve Account (NOT P&L)
Share_Forfeiture_entry: Share Capital A/c Dr (Called-up amount) | To Share Allotment/Call A/c | To Share Forfeiture A/c
Re_issue_at_discount: Share Forfeiture A/c Dr (discount allowed) | To Share Capital A/c | Bank A/c Dr | To Share Capital A/c
Capital_Reserve_on_reissue: Capital Reserve = Balance in Share Forfeiture A/c after re-issue
Current_Ratio: Current Assets / Current Liabilities [Ideal: 2:1]
Quick_Ratio: Quick Assets / Current Liabilities [Ideal: 1:1]
Quick_Assets: Current Assets – Inventories – Prepaid Expenses
Debt_to_Equity_Ratio: Long-term Debt / Shareholders' Funds
Debt: Long-term Borrowings + Long-term Provisions
Shareholders_Funds: Share Capital + Reserves and Surplus
Proprietary_Ratio: Shareholders' Funds / Total Assets
Interest_Coverage_Ratio: Net Profit before Interest and Tax / Interest on Long-term Debt
Inventory_Turnover_Ratio: Cost of Revenue from Operations / Average Inventory
Trade_Receivables_Turnover: Net Credit Revenue from Operations / Average Trade Receivables
Trade_Payables_Turnover: Net Credit Purchases / Average Trade Payables
Working_Capital_Turnover: Revenue from Operations / Working Capital
Gross_Profit_Ratio: Gross Profit / Revenue from Operations × 100
Net_Profit_Ratio: Net Profit after Tax / Revenue from Operations × 100
Operating_Ratio: (Cost of Revenue from Operations + Operating Expenses) / Revenue × 100
Operating_Profit_Ratio: Operating Profit / Revenue from Operations × 100
Return_on_Investment: Net Profit before Interest and Tax / Capital Employed × 100
Return_on_Shareholders_Funds: Profit after Tax / Shareholders' Funds × 100
EPS: Profit available for Equity Shareholders / Number of Equity Shares
Book_Value_per_Share: Equity Shareholders' Funds / Number of Equity Shares
Dividend_Payout_Ratio: Dividend per Share / Earnings per Share
Price_Earning_Ratio: Market Price of Share / Earnings per Share
Start_with: Net Profit before Tax and Extraordinary Items
Add_non_cash_charges: ['Depreciation', 'Loss on sale of fixed assets', 'Discount written off (on shares/debentures)', 'Goodwill written off', 'Preliminary expenses written off']
Less_non_cash_incomes: ['Profit on sale of fixed assets', 'Profit on sale of investments', 'Dividend received (for non-finance companies)', 'Interest received (for non-finance companies)']
Add_increase_in_current_liabilities: Add: Increase in Trade Payables, Outstanding Expenses
Less_decrease_in_current_liabilities: Less: Decrease in Trade Payables
Add_decrease_in_current_assets: Add: Decrease in Debtors, Decrease in Inventories
Less_increase_in_current_assets: Less: Increase in Debtors, Increase in Inventories, Increase in Prepaid Expenses

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: UP Board Accountancy is theory-only (100 marks). No practical or project component.

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: Medium to Difficult. LA (Q27-Q30) covered numerical type along with theory questions with choice.
most_difficult_sections: LA (Q27-Q30, 40 marks) — numerical journal entries and ledger accounts

tips: Q1-Q26 ALL compulsory — never leave any blank. Even partial working gets marks in numericals
Only Q27-Q30 have OR — choose either theory OR numerical based on your strength
Goodwill MCQ trap: Always check if question says 'average profit method' (multiply by years) or 'super profit method' (deduct normal profit first)
Partnership trap: Interest on drawings is INCOME for firm; Interest on capital is EXPENSE for firm
Rent paid to partner → P&L Account (charge against profit). NOT P&L Appropriation
Revaluation profit/loss → always distributed in OLD profit sharing ratio
Goodwill on admission → distributed in SACRIFICING ratio
Goodwill on retirement → borne by continuing partners in GAINING ratio
Capital A/c balance on dissolution → transferred to REALISATION ACCOUNT (not P&L)
Share Forfeiture A/c balance after re-issue → transferred to CAPITAL RESERVE (very common MCQ)
Minimum subscription = 90% (SEBI); Min application money = 5% of face value
Debentureholder gets INTEREST (fixed rate) — NOT dividend, NOT voting rights
Zero Coupon Bonds = issued at zero rate of interest (MCQ trap: NOT at zero price)
Discount on issue of debentures = Capital Loss (written off against Securities Premium or P&L)
Cash Flow: Increase in current liability = ADD; Decrease = DEDUCT. Increase in current asset = DEDUCT; Decrease = ADD
Current Ratio ideal = 2:1; Quick/Liquid Ratio ideal = 1:1 — very high MCQ frequency

time_allocation.note: First 15 min: read all questions. For Q27-Q30, decide whether to attempt theory or numerical OR option.
10 marks. All compulsory. For numerical MCQs (goodwill, ratio), do rough work quickly.
20 marks. All compulsory. 30 words max. Definitions and 2 key points.
30 marks. All compulsory. Small numericals here too. 100 words or complete working.
40 marks. Each has OR. Show complete working — partial credit given for correct steps.
Recheck journal entries (Dr/Cr), ratio formula, signs in cash flow.

focus_areas: MCQ: Current ratio ideal 2:1, liquid 1:1; goodwill in sacrificing ratio; capital balance to realisation
VSA: Define partnership, partnership deed, debenture, share, goodwill — all easy definitions
SA Q21 (super profit goodwill) and Q23 (types of preference shares)
LA Q27: Attempt theory OR (company characteristics) if numericals feel difficult
SA: Types of debentures, objectives of financial statements, dissolution of firm
LA: Realisation account (standard format) OR Dissolution theory
Ratio numericals: Current ratio + GP ratio + NP ratio practice
All ratio formulas memorised — both formula and ideal value
Journal entry formats perfect — Share allotment, forfeiture, re-issue
Cash flow statement indirect method — all adjustments rules memorised
Partnership admission/retirement: complete workings with capital adjustment
